title: The Last Islander to Touch It: Billy Smith and the First Goalie Goal
deck: November 28, 1979. A delayed penalty in Denver, a blind pass to nobody and a puck that slid into an empty net. How Billy Smith became the first goaltender credited with an NHL goal, and why goalie goals keep coming.
